Welcome to Oakwood Primary Academy
Thank you on behalf of all of us here at Oakwood Primary Academy for visiting our website. It is our hope that this website will provide you with the most up-to-date and useful information about our school and share insight into the fantastic teaching and learning taking place here. As you will see, we are very proud of what our school community achieves and hope that this shines through, but if you do have any unanswered questions, please don't hesitate to get in touch.
Oakwood Primary Academy is a thriving primary school, situated in the heart of Willingdon Trees. We provide a nurturing and inspiring education for just over 300 pupils currently on roll, ranging from our onsite Nursery and Early Years Foundation Stage Village through to our oldest children in Year 6. As one of the seven schools across the Aurora Academies Trust (spanning East Sussex, Brighton and Surrey), we benefit from our multi-academy trust network of innovation and support, but what continues to make our school special, is our school vision & values and its community feel.

Special Educational Needs and/or Disabilities
Oakwood is an inclusive school with children at the heart of everything we do! We work hard to provide a learning environment and offer provision that supports all our children to make the best possible progress in their learning.
Mrs Wood (our Assistant Headteacher for Inclusion and SENDCo) would be delighted to talk with you about our 'offer' in school and regularly publishes a termly inclusion newsletter around 'all things inclusion!'
This year (2025-26) we are proud to be part of the PINs Project in East Sussex, which raises the profile of Neurodiversity in schools and evolve teachers' practice. Please do look out for details of upcoming coffee mornings which will provide further information on this!
Our Inclusion Team are here to help and can be contacted via the School Office: 01323 501251 or OPAoffice@oakwoodpa.org.uk Our Inclusion Team consists of:
Mrs Wood Assistant Headteacher for Inclusion/SENDCo/DSL
Mrs Mack Inclusion Administrator
Mrs Snelgrove Pastoral Manager
Mrs Taylor Pastoral Assistant/Intervention

Breakfast Club
Our breakfast club for YR to Y6, runs from 7.45am each morning, Monday to Friday. Children may enter via the side entrance next to the main hall.
The price is £3.50 per session, to be booked and paid for in advance using Arbor Pay. We kindly request that bookings are made with at least 24 hours' notice.
Children can enjoy activities in the school hall and can enjoy fruit juices, cereal and toast. Each Friday, we also have a hot breakfast offering, such as a sausage sandwich. Our staff will ensure the children are taken to their classrooms from 8.30am each morning.
WAFFLE WEDNESDAYS OCTOBER 2025
On 1st, 8th, 15th and 22nd October 2025, we are pleased to offer your children waffles & pancakes, with fruit in addition to fruit juices, cereal and toast.
Please book via the Arbor App - we have 26 places available - these are booking up fast!

After School Clubs & Wraparound Care
The school offers after school clubs Monday to Friday, run by members of our school staff.
The cost per session is £4 and details are sent out via a letter or in our weekly bulletin.
Clubs run until 4.30pm, Monday to Friday. All school run clubs (not Sportitude-run clubs) must be booked via Arbor Pay and enquiries can be made to the school office. opaoffice@oakwoodpa.org.uk
For wraparound care for the period 4.30pm up to 5.30pm, an additional fee of £6 is payable. This can be booked via the Arbor app. We kindly ask that you book in advance for all clubs and wraparound care so that we may plan activities.
For school after school clubs, parents can book places via the Arbor App.
TERM 2 CLUBS - NOW BOOKING FOR 3RD NOVEMBER - 19TH DECEMBER 2025
